facts.fact: Launchbase Africa reports Instruction 06-2025 requires payment service providers to integrate with the national payment and clearing systems overseen by the Bank of Algeria.

Launchbase Africa reports Bank of Algeria Instruction 06-2025 of 17 August 2025 requires payment service providers to hold customer funds in segregated escrow accounts, carry a bank guarantee or liability insurance, and give users contracts setting out fees and dispute resolution procedures.
